summary: Read a sequence of integers. Its length is from 1 to 100, and each integer is from 0 to 100. Rewrite that same sequence into the next greater ordering under dictionary order, keeping the new ordering in the original slots. When no greater ordering exists, rewrite the sequence into the smallest ordering, increasing from left to right. Extra scratch space must stay a fixed amount and must not grow with the length.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
